research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Disclo is focused on developing systems and methods for managing workplace accommodations. Their research involves creating methods for generating and evaluating requests for workplace accommodations based on disabilities. This includes validating these accommodations with medical providers to ensure appropriateness. Disclo's work aims to streamline the process of handling employee health disclosures and accommodation requests, ensuring compliance with regulations.

about_short_description.short_description: Disclo is HIPAA compliant software for employers to collect, verify, and manage employee health disclosures and accommodation requests.

product.name: Disclo Workplace Accommodations Software
product.description: A HIPAA-compliant platform for employers to collect, verify, and manage employee health disclosures and accommodation requests in compliance with ADA regulations.

product.name: Disclo Hire Interview Accommodations Tool
product.description: A tool to manage and provide accommodations for job candidates during the interview process, ensuring compliance and accessibility from the start of hiring.

product.name: Disclo Automated Accommodation Workflows
product.description: Automated workflows that guide employees through accommodation requests and streamline medical verification and HR communications.

product.name: Disclo Compliance and Reporting Portal
product.description: A user-friendly, HIPAA and SOC2 compliant portal for managing accommodation requests and ensuring regulatory compliance.

product.name: Disclo Expert Guidance and Support
product.description: On-demand access to workplace accommodation experts who provide advice and support throughout the accommodation process.
